top_story_title: Ivanti Connect Secure authentication bypass (CVE-2026-104935) exploited as a zero-day since October 1; CISA deadline is 16 October
top_story_summary: CISA has added CVE-2026-104935 to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog (added 13 October 2026, remediation due 16 October 2026) and urged organisations to update Ivanti Connect Secure appliances immediately. CISA describes it as an authentication bypass by spoofing that lets a remote, unauthenticated attacker execute arbitrary commands; reporting puts the CVSS score at 8.6. BleepingComputer reports exploitation as a zero-day since at least 1 October, and The Hacker News reports honeypots logging 105 exploit attempts.
top_actions: Inventory every Ivanti Connect Secure appliance and compare the running build against Ivanti's advisory for CVE-2026-104935; check the vendor advisory for the fixed release. Do not assume the July patch covers this.
Patch to the vendor's fixed build and run the Ivanti Integrity Checker Tool; treat an ICT failure as confirmed compromise and escalate to IR.
Terminate all active sessions and revoke session tokens after upgrade; assume stolen session cookies are in use.
Rotate certificates, service-account credentials, local admin passwords and any secrets stored on the appliance.
Hunt for compromise on appliances exposed since 1 October: unexpected outbound connections, new local accounts, modified web resources, unusual timestamps in /var logs.
executive_summary: Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935 (unauthenticated auth bypass to command execution, CVSS 8.6) has been exploited as a zero-day since at least 1 October; CISA's KEV due date is 16 October 2026 and honeypots have logged 105 exploit attempts. The July patch was only partial - re-verify the running build.

Palo Alto Networks patched PAN-OS CVE-2026-0322, an authenticated RCE in the management interface, after limited exploitation against customer firewalls; KEV due 17 October 2026 and IoCs are published.

Cisco patched an actively exploited Secure Email Gateway arbitrary file write (KEV: CVE-2026-76519) reachable by an unauthenticated sender via a crafted email attachment when file reputation is enabled, leading to root command execution. There is no workaround.

Unit 42 reports attackers used FortiManager CVE-2024-47575 (KEV since October 2024) to reach 500+ firewalls and deploy PEERSTITCH, a memory-resident ARM64 FortiGate implant - a two-year-old management-plane bug still delivering firewall persistence.

Palo Alto Networks' October bundle also carries lower-severity PAN-OS and GlobalProtect app fixes (command injection, Panorama DoS, network-services DoS, XSS, client-side LPE/DoS); fold them into the same change window as CVE-2026-0322.
Cisco has pre-announced a 21 October 2026 advisory bundle covering Expressway Series, IOS XR for ASR 9000 Series routers, Secure Client, Snort and Unified Communications.
key_actions: **Multiple** — Pull the KEV list and map CVE-2026-0322 and CVE-2026-76519 against your asset inventory by model and running version.
**Multiple** — Apply the vendor fixed releases for PAN-OS and Cisco Secure Email Gateway; check each vendor advisory for the fixed release, as this item states none.
**Ivanti** — Re-verify the running build on every Connect Secure appliance against Ivanti's current advisory for CVE-2026-104935 - do not rely on the July change record.
**Ivanti** — Patch to the vendor's fixed build and run the Ivanti Integrity Checker Tool; check the vendor advisory for the fixed release.
**Palo Alto Networks** — Confirm the running PAN-OS version against the vendor's fixed-release table and schedule the upgrade inside the change window, HA pair secondary first.
**Palo Alto Networks** — Remove management access (HTTPS/SSH/API) from any untrusted or internet-facing interface; restrict to a dedicated management VLAN or out-of-band network.
**Palo Alto Networks** — Patch to the vendor's fixed PAN-OS release now; check the vendor advisory for the fixed release.

**Palo Alto Networks** — Treat any firewall whose management interface was reachable from an untrusted network before patching as potentially compromised and run a configuration diff against a known-good backup.

ai_defenses.solution: Strengthening the Foundation: A Predictable, Customer-Focused Response to AI-Accelerated Vulnerability Discovery
ai_defenses.what_it_does: Cisco's documented change to how PSIRT discloses vulnerabilities, referenced from its advance notification of the 21 October 2026 advisory bundle. In the same cycle Cisco grouped internally discovered Secure Email Gateway issues by CWE class under a single CVE ID per grouping and shipped them as scheduled hardening releases.

headlines.title: CISA flags exploited flaws in Palo Alto, Cisco and Ahsay products
headlines.summary: CISA added four actively exploited flaws to KEV, including a PAN-OS management-interface RCE and a critical path traversal in Cisco Secure Email Gateway.

headlines.title: Ivanti ICS Zero-Day Attacks Highlight Vendor Patching Hurdles
headlines.summary: An incomplete July fix left Ivanti Connect Secure exposed to CVE-2026-104935, a high-severity authentication bypass chained to RCE now exploited in the wild.

headlines.title: CVE-2026-0322 PAN-OS: Authenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE) in the Management Interface (Severity: HIGH)
headlines.summary: Palo Alto Networks' advisory for CVE-2026-0322 confirms an authenticated remote code execution flaw in the PAN-OS management interface, rated high.

headlines.title: Palo Alto Networks warns of PAN-OS RCE flaw exploited in attacks
headlines.summary: PAN-OS zero-day CVE-2026-0322 was exploited in attacks against firewalls before Palo Alto Networks shipped security updates.

headlines.title: CISA Urges Immediate Ivanti Connect Secure Updates as Honeypots Log 105 Exploit Attempts
headlines.summary: CISA told organisations to update Ivanti Connect Secure immediately against CVE-2026-104935 (CVSS 8.6) as honeypots logged 105 exploit attempts.

headlines.title: Unit 42 Uncovers PEERSTITCH, a Stealthy FortiGate Implant
headlines.summary: Unit 42 found attackers exploiting FortiManager CVE-2024-47575 to reach 500+ firewalls and plant PEERSTITCH, a memory-resident ARM64 FortiGate implant.
